follow-up time: Through hospital stay until discharge home or death
cohort: 135 preterm infants with birth weight less than 1500g admitted to the NICU.
finding: Intraventricular haemorrhage (IVH) was present in 33.3% of neonates <1500g, with lower gestational age and birth weight associated with increased risk of IVH and severe IVH associated with increased mortality.
mod_finding: Caesarean section had a favorable effect on babies without IVH.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was lower in infants with IVH (28.1 weeks) compared to those without (29.26 weeks).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was lower in infants with IVH (887g) compared to those without (979g).
